expansion_rule: direct postsynaptic partners of seeds on >=5-synapse edges; upstream excluded
edge_rule: induced edges among selected nodes (>=5 synapses)
entry_subset_rule: the 210 LPLC2 seeds (sensory encoder projects here)
notes: Downstream-only expansion declared before training because the source export is dominated by LPLC2 upstream columnar fan-in (5312 neurons) with no principled engineered input interface for them; LPLC2 is the documented entry stage of this candidate circuit. This is an engineered selection, not a claim of completeness.
